caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned upright and centered against a plain, off-white or beige background. The object has a conical shape with a wide circular base and a narrower top. The lower section is wider and tapers upward, colored with earthy brown, reddish, and tan hues, giving it a textured, possibly wooden or animal-horn appearance. The top section consists of a shorter cylindrical form colored in muted greenish tones, separated from the lower portion by two horizontal ring-like bands. The base and upper rim also have slightly darker outlines, suggesting a metallic or reinforced edge. There are no other objects present, and in the lower right corner, the name “ROSE CAMPBELL” is written in small, neat capital letters.
